'''Premiere &ndash; Hoth''' (display name '''Premiere - Hoth'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_hoth</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]].

Decipher Deck Designs from early 1997 (through April, before [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]]) used this pool. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref> the same environment is <code>premiere_hoth</code> (set ids 1&ndash;3 plus premium ids 101&ndash;104).

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
